unitTitle: Plurals - Countable/Uncountable Nouns - How Much/How Many - A Few/A Little - Some/Any
scanNote:
GRAMMAR 36-BET. Unit 8 — how much/how many, a few/a little, some/any.

Skaner bilan tekshirildi. HAMMASI TO'G'RI: 5-mashq (5), 6-mashq (20), 7-mashq (8 bo'shliq), 8-mashq (12 ta C/U), 9-mashq (10 juftlik), 10-mashq (5 savol) — jami 60 ta javob.

⚠ HAMMA MASHQNING BITTA KALITI — OT SANALADIMI:
  SANALADIGAN (C): tomato, cucumber, peach, coconut, onion, strawberry
     → how MANY · a FEW · ko'plikda 'some/any'
  SANALMAYDIGAN (U): tea, bacon, milk, butter, salt, rice
     → how MUCH · a LITTLE · birlikda 'some/any'
  ⚠ 8-mashqda 12 ta ot tasniflanadi va shu tasnif qolgan mashqlarning javobini belgilaydi.

⚠ ChALKAShTIRUVChI OTLAR: 'bacon' va 'butter' — go'sht va sariyog' bo'lagi ko'rinsa ham SANALMAYDI. 'coconut' esa butun meva bo'lgani uchun SANALADI.

⚠ 9-MAShQ — BESh XIL FARQ:
  1: inkorda 'any' ('some' emas)
  2 va 3: 'I'd like' / 'Would you like' — taklif, shuning uchun 'some'; 'I like' / 'Do you like' esa umumiy yoqtirish — bu yerda mos emas
  4: 'cherries' sanaladi → how many
  5: 'rice' sanalmaydi → 'a rice' xato
  7: inkorda 'any' ('I'd like any coffee' xato)
  8: narx so'ralganda 'How MUCH is it?'
  9: savolda 'do' shart — 'How much DO you want?'
  10: 'Is there ANYTHING' ('Is this anything' xato)

⚠ 10-MAShQ — 'DOES' yoki 'DO': Andy, Susan, he → DOES; your parents, you → DO.

sections.title: How much - How many - A Few - A Little - Some - Any
sections.titleUz: How much - How many - A Few - A Little - Some - Any

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in How much or How many.
exercises.instructionUz: How much yoki How many qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
QOIDA:
  HOW MUCH → SANALMAYDIGAN ot bilan
  HOW MANY → SANALADIGAN ot (KO'PLIK) bilan

OTNI TEKSHIRISH USULI:
  Ot -S bilan tugaganmi? → odatda SANALADIGAN → HOW MANY
  Ot -S siz va massa/suyuqlikmi? → SANALMAYDIGAN → HOW MUCH

items.whyUz: 'potatoes' — SANALADIGAN, KO'PLIKDA → HOW MANY.
'sugar' — SANALMAYDIGAN → HOW MUCH.

items.textEn: 3  ............ milk is there in the fridge?
items.whyUz:
'milk' — SANALMAYDIGAN → HOW MUCH.
Fe'l 'IS' ham buni tasdiqlaydi (ko'plik bo'lsa 'are' bo'lardi).
'eggs' — SANALADIGAN, KO'PLIKDA → HOW MANY.

'ham' — SANALMAYDIGAN → HOW MUCH.
Sanash uchun: 'How many SLICES of ham?'

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in: how much, how many, a few, a little, some or any.
exercises.instructionUz: how much, how many, a few, a little, some yoki any qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI SO'ZNING ISHLATILISHI:

  SANALADIGAN (ko'plik)     SANALMAYDIGAN
     how many                 how much
     a few                    a little

  SOME → tasdiq gap, TAKLIF va ILTIMOS savoli
  ANY  → inkor gap va MA'LUMOT savoli

DIALOG QOLIPI:
  SAVOL: How much/many + ot ...?
  JAVOB: Just a little / a few, please.

Har bir dialogda AVVAL otni aniqlang —
sanaladigan yoki sanalmaydigan ekanini.

items.textEn: 1  A: ............ bananas would you like, sir?
items.whyUz: SANALADIGAN, KO'PLIKDA → HOW MANY.

SANALADIGAN → A FEW.
'a little' faqat sanalmaydigan otlar bilan.
'Can I have ...?' — ILTIMOS (request) → SOME.

items.textEn: 2  B: Sorry, we haven't got ............ milk.
items.whyUz: INKOR gap ('haven't got') → ANY.
'bread' — SANALMAYDIGAN → HOW MUCH.

SANALMAYDIGAN → A LITTLE.
1-band bilan solishtiring: bananas → a few, bread → a little.
SANALADIGAN, KO'PLIKDA → HOW MANY.

SANALADIGAN → A FEW.
'only a few' = atigi bir nechta.
SANALADIGAN, KO'PLIKDA → HOW MANY.
INKOR gap ('don't need') → ANY.

items.textEn: 6  A: ............ sugar would you like in your coffee?
items.whyUz: 'sugar' — SANALMAYDIGAN → HOW MUCH.

SANALMAYDIGAN → A LITTLE.
Coursebook 57-betdagi 15-mashqning 10-bandi bilan bir xil holat.

items.textEn: 7  A: Could I have ............ tea, please?
items.whyUz:
'Could I have ...?' — ILTIMOS (request) → SOME.
'Could' — 'Can' dan MULOYIMROQ.

items.textEn: 7  B: Of course. Would you like ............ biscuits, too?
items.whyUz:
'Would you like ...?' — TAKLIF (offer) → SOME.
Ikkala savolda ham SOME, lekin biri iltimos, biri taklif.

items.textEn: 8  A: Is there ............ wine in the fridge?
items.whyUz: Oddiy MA'LUMOT savoli (taklif ham, iltimos ham emas) → ANY.

items.textEn: 8  B: No, we need to buy ............ .
items.whyUz:
TASDIQ gap ('we need to buy') → SOME.
'No' bilan boshlangan bo'lsa ham, gapning o'zi tasdiq.
'flour' (un) — SANALMAYDIGAN → HOW MUCH.
SANALMAYDIGAN → A LITTLE.

'Have you got ...?' — MA'LUMOT savoli → ANY.
Nazariya qutisidagi misol bilan bir xil (34-bet).

SANALADIGAN, KO'PLIKDA → HOW MANY.
Ot takrorlanmagan, lekin 'potatoes' nazarda tutilyapti.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in: some, any, is, are, much or many.
exercises.instructionUz: some, any, is, are, much yoki many qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI DIALOG — DO'KONDAGI SUHBAT.

1-DIALOG (to'ldirilgan holda):
  A: I'd like SOME eggs, please.
  B: Of course. How MANY would you like?
  A: Six, please. ARE there ANY tomatoes?
  B: Certainly. How MANY do you need?
  A: A kilo, please.

2-DIALOG (to'ldirilgan holda):
  A: I'd like SOME olive oil.
  B: How MUCH do you need?
  A: Half a bottle. IS there ANY flour?
  B: Certainly. How MUCH do you need?
  A: A kilo, please.

IKKI DIALOGNI SOLISHTIRING:
  1-dialog — 'eggs' va 'tomatoes' SANALADIGAN → MANY, ARE
  2-dialog — 'olive oil' va 'flour' SANALMAYDIGAN → MUCH, IS

DIQQAT — 'IS' yoki 'ARE':
  ARE there any TOMATOES?  (ko'plik)
  IS there any FLOUR?      (sanalmaydigan → birlik)

items.whyUz: TASDIQ gap ('I'd like') → SOME.

items.textEn: 1  B: Of course. How 2) ............ would you like?
items.whyUz: 'eggs' — SANALADIGAN → HOW MANY.

'tomatoes' — KO'PLIK → 'ARE there ...?'
MA'LUMOT savoli → ANY.

items.textEn: 1  B: Certainly. How 5) ............ do you need?
items.whyUz:
'tomatoes' — SANALADIGAN → HOW MANY.
'A kilo' javob bo'lsa ham, ot sanaladi.

TASDIQ gap → SOME.
'olive oil' (zaytun moyi) — SANALMAYDIGAN.

'olive oil' — SANALMAYDIGAN → HOW MUCH.
1-dialogning 2-bandi bilan solishtiring: eggs → many, oil → much.

items.textEn: 2  A: Half a bottle. 3) ............ there 4) ............ flour?
items.whyUz:
'flour' — SANALMAYDIGAN → 'IS there ...?' (birlik fe'l).
MA'LUMOT savoli → ANY.
1-dialog bilan solishtiring: 'ARE there any tomatoes?' (ko'plik).

items.textEn: 2  B: Certainly. How 5) ............ do you need?
items.whyUz: 'flour' — SANALMAYDIGAN → HOW MUCH.

exercises.instructionEn: Write C for countable or U for uncountable as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Sanaladigan uchun C, sanalmaydigan uchun U yozing, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
C = countable (sanaladigan)
U = uncountable (sanalmaydigan)

TEKSHIRISH USULI:
  Otning oldiga son qo'yib ko'ring:
     'two tomatoes' — mumkin → C
     'two teas' — odatda mumkin emas → U

SANALMAYDIGAN OTLAR ODATDA:
  suyuqlik (tea, milk)
  kukun/donador (salt, rice)
  massa (bacon, butter)

KITOBDA BERILGAN: 1 = C.

items.whyUz:
Kitobda BERILGAN javob: C.
'one tomato, two tomatoes' — sanash mumkin.

SANALMAYDIGAN — suyuqlik.
Sanash uchun: 'a cup of tea'.

SANALADIGAN — 'one cucumber, two cucumbers'.
'a cucumber' /ˈkjuːkʌmbə/ = bodring.
SANALADIGAN — 'one peach, two peaches' (-ch → -ES).

SANALMAYDIGAN — massa.
Sanash uchun: 'a slice of bacon'.

SANALMAYDIGAN — suyuqlik.
Sanash uchun: 'a glass of milk', 'a carton of milk'.

SANALADIGAN — 'one coconut, two coconuts'.
DIQQAT: 'coconut milk' esa SANALMAYDIGAN.

SANALMAYDIGAN — massa.
34-betdagi nazariya qutisida ham misol sifatida berilgan.
SANALADIGAN — 'an onion, two onions'.

SANALMAYDIGAN — kukun.
'a salt' XATO.
SANALADIGAN — 'one strawberry, two strawberries'.

SANALMAYDIGAN — donalarini sanab bo'lmaydi.
'a rice' XATO (9-mashqning 5-bandida ham shu xato bor).

exercises.instructionEn: Tick the correct sentences, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
HAR JUFTLIKDA FAQAT BITTASI TO'G'RI.

TEKSHIRILADIGAN QOIDALAR:
  • INKOR gapda ANY (some emas)
  • 'I'd like' (xohlayman) va 'I like' (yoqtiraman) farqi
  • TAKLIF savolida 'Would you like' (Do you like emas)
  • HOW MUCH / HOW MANY to'g'ri tanlash
  • SANALMAYDIGAN otga 'a' qo'yilmaydi
  • Savolda DO/DOES yordamchi fe'li shart
  • 'Is there anything ...?' o'zgarmas qolip

KITOBDA BERILGAN: 1b to'g'ri.

options: b  There aren't any tomatoes in the fridge.
a  There aren't some tomatoes in the fridge.
items.answer: b  There aren't any tomatoes in the fridge.
items.whyUz:
Kitobda BERILGAN javob.
INKOR gapda ANY ishlatiladi ('some' XATO).

options: a  I'd like some soup, please.
b  I like some soup, please.
items.answer: a  I'd like some soup, please.
items.whyUz:
'I'D LIKE' = xohlayman (buyurtma).
'I like' = yoqtiraman (umumiy) — 'please' bilan mos kelmaydi.

options: a  Would you like some orange juice?
b  Do you like some orange juice?
items.answer: a  Would you like some orange juice?
items.whyUz:
TAKLIF savoli 'WOULD you like ...?' bilan.
'Do you like ...?' — umumiy yoqtirish savoli, 'some' bilan kelmaydi.

options: b  How many cherries do you need?
a  How much cherries do you need?
items.answer: b  How many cherries do you need?
items.whyUz: 'cherries' — SANALADIGAN, KO'PLIKDA → HOW MANY.

options: a  I'd like some rice for lunch.
b  I'd like a rice for lunch.
items.answer: a  I'd like some rice for lunch.
items.whyUz:
'rice' — SANALMAYDIGAN → 'a' ISHLATILMAYDI → SOME rice.
8-mashqning 12-bandi bilan bog'liq.

options: a  Would you like some bread?
b  Do you like some bread?
items.answer: a  Would you like some bread?
items.whyUz:
TAKLIF savoli → 'Would you like ...?'
3-band bilan bir xil qoida.

options: a  No thanks. I don't want any coffee.
b  No thanks. I'd like any coffee.
items.answer: a  No thanks. I don't want any coffee.
items.whyUz:
INKOR gap ('don't want') → ANY.
'I'd like any coffee' — mantiqsiz: 'I'd like' tasdiq, 'any' esa inkor uchun.

options: b  "Here's your hamburger." "How much is it?"
a  "Here's your hamburger." "How many is it?"
items.answer: b  "Here's your hamburger." "How much is it?"
items.whyUz:
NARX so'rash uchun DOIM 'How much is it?'
'How many is it?' — grammatik jihatdan ham noto'g'ri.

options: b  How much do you want?
items.answer: b  How much do you want?
items.whyUz:
Present Simple savolida DO yordamchi fe'li SHART.
'How much you want?' — yordamchi fe'l yo'q → XATO.

options: a  I'm hungry. Is there anything to eat?
b  I'm hungry. Is this anything to eat?
items.answer: a  I'm hungry. Is there anything to eat?
items.whyUz:
'Is there anything to eat/drink?' — o'zgarmas qolip.
Coursebook 56-betda ham shu ibora bor edi.
'Is this anything to eat?' — ma'nosiz.

exercises.instructionEn: Write questions using the verb like, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  1  Andy/school?  →  Does Andy like school?

QOLIP:
  DO/DOES + ega + LIKE + to'ldiruvchi?

'DO' yoki 'DOES':
  he, she, it, ism (birlik) → DOES
  I, you, we, they, ko'plik → DO

DIQQAT: 'does' bor bo'lsa, 'like' ga -S QO'ShILMAYDI:
  'Does Andy likeS school?' XATO.

DIQQAT — 'LIKE' dan keyin FE'L kelsa:
  'like + fe'l-ING' → Do your parents like READING?
                      Do you like EXERCISING?

items.question: Does Andy like school?
items.whyUz:
Kitobda BERILGAN namuna.
'Andy' — birlik 3-shaxs → DOES.

items.question: Does Susan like the theatre?
items.whyUz:
'Susan' — birlik 3-shaxs → DOES.
'the theatre' — THE bilan (bino/muassasa sifatida).
Talaffuz: /ˈθɪətə/.

items.question: Do your parents like reading?
items.whyUz:
'your parents' — KO'PLIK → DO.
'like + fe'l-ING' → 'like READING'.

items.question: Does he like rock music?
items.whyUz:
'he' — birlik 3-shaxs → DOES.
'rock music' — SANALMAYDIGAN, artiklsiz.

items.question: Do you like exercising?
items.whyUz:
'you' → DO.
'like + fe'l-ING' → 'like EXERCISING'.
'to exercise' = mashq qilmoq, sport bilan shug'ullanmoq.

wordFormation.introUz: 36-bet — miqdor so'zlari jadvali va yangi ovqat otlari.

groups.explanationUz: Otning turiga qarab tanlanadi. Bu jadvalni yod oling.
Bir xil ma'no, turli muloyimlik darajasi.

patterns.formula: How much/many + ot + do you need/want? — Just a little / a few, please.
patterns.exampleEn: How much bread would you like? — Just a little, please.
patterns.exampleUz: Sizga qancha non kerak? — Bir oz, iltimos.

patterns.formula: IS there any + sanalmaydigan?  /  ARE there any + ko'plik?
patterns.exampleEn: Is there any flour? Are there any tomatoes?
patterns.explanationUz:
Sanalmaydigan ot BIRLIK hisoblanadi → IS.
Sanaladigan ko'plik → ARE.

patterns.exampleEn: I'd like some eggs, please. I'd like some olive oil.
patterns.exampleUz: Menga tuxum bering, iltimos. Menga zaytun moyi kerak.

patterns.exampleEn: Does Andy like school? Do you like exercising?
patterns.exampleUz: Endi maktabni yoqtiradimi? Siz sport bilan shug'ullanishni yoqtirasizmi?
patterns.explanationUz:
'does' bor bo'lsa 'like' ga -S QO'ShILMAYDI.
'like' dan keyin fe'l -ING bilan keladi.

patterns.exampleEn: Here's your hamburger. — How much is it?
patterns.explanationUz: Narx uchun DOIM 'How MUCH' — 'How many is it?' XATO.

patterns.exampleEn: I'm hungry. Is there anything to eat?
patterns.exampleUz: Qornim ochdi. Yegani bir narsa bormi?
